# Jamie de Rooij

> Jamie de Rooij is an independent Dutch graphic designer based in Amsterdam, working at the intersection of creativity, research and experimentation: art direction, branding, digital and editorial design, print, webdesign and Framer development.

The site is a single page with a selection of work (posters, books, campaigns, websites and tools), a wall of posters and a short about section.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.jamiederooij.com/): selected works, poster wall and about
- [Works](https://www.jamiederooij.com/#works): images, videos and slideshows of projects, each with title, description and discipline
- [About](https://www.jamiederooij.com/#about): approach, services and recognition
